from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EarningsData(BaseModel):
    """One company's consolidated net income data for the comparison period."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the filing")
    current_period_label: str | None = Field(description="Line-item label as written for current period (e.g., 'Net Income', 'Consolidated Net Income', 'Net Income (loss)')")
    current_period_income: float | None = Field(description="Net income amount for the most recent quarter; losses should be negative values")
    current_period_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    prior_period_label: str | None = Field(description="Line-item label as written for prior period")
    prior_period_income: float | None = Field(description="Net income amount for the same quarter in the prior year; losses should be negative values")
    prior_period_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The period the data covers (e.g., 'three months ended March 31, 2025')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line or excerpt containing the income figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    earnings_data: list[EarningsData]
